title: Golden Impossible-Space Proof & MSWI Handoff
objective: Automate and prove the full MSLR family battery with exact-head validation, deterministic replay where declared, provider-off operation, permission filtering, accessible cue parity, clean-room boundaries and a typed non-authoritative handoff to MSWI; include projection invariance, true hyperbolic tiling, quotient/non-orientable topology, bounded lazy unbounded-space operation, and discrete-vs-continuous realization of the same accepted law.
acceptance: The complete closed MSLR family proof battery passes against the sealed MSLR-01/03/04/07/08/13/14/16 contracts without reopening them.
Exact-head Linux and hosted-Windows validation plus deterministic comparison prove the terminal family candidate.
Deterministic replay reproduces every MSLR behavior declared deterministic while preserving immutable Event history.
Permission filtering occurs before participant-facing route, navigation, diagnostic, cue and explanation projections.
Blocking workflows prove semantic/nonvisual and keyboard-equivalent cue parity and provider-off local operation without paid-cloud or mandatory-3D dependence.
Projection/resolution invariance proves presentation changes do not change accepted spatial-law meaning or canonical identity.
True hyperbolic tiling is proven through an accepted specialized generator path without turning regular tiling math into a universal MSLR law.
Quotient and non-orientable topology cases preserve canonical identity, local-frame semantics and owner boundaries.
Bounded lazy operation demonstrates practically unbounded represented space without exhaustive enumeration.
Discrete traversal and continuous geometry realizations are proven semantically equivalent for the same accepted spatial law.
Clean-room proof confirms external hyperbolic/HyperRogue material supplied architecture/research guidance only and no protected implementation/expression is incorporated.
A typed MSWI-01 handoff is produced only after terminal MSLR proof; it does not select, start or grant MSWI implementation authority.
boundaries: MSLR-01/03/04/07/08/13/14/16 and all upstream completed programs remain sealed.
World/Reality/Scene/Transition/Portal/Visibility/Knowledge/Action/Event and specialist owner contracts retain canonical authority.
MCS and other presentation systems remain projection owners rather than spatial-truth owners.
GPR/Action/Event retain generic execution and immutable Event history.
External reference implementations, assets, layouts, UI expression, save formats and proprietary/private protocols remain excluded by clean-room boundary.
MSWI is downstream only; terminal cross-family GPR-slot reuse requires a later explicit owner Continue after MSLR-18 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for the complete MSLR terminal proof battery, amended impossible-space cases, exact-head family proof and non-authoritative MSWI-01 handoff.
